entities.description: A full-body shot of a standing Black man with a serious expression, wearing a red and brown striped tunic with fringed edges, a white sash, and a blue beaded necklace with a large white pendant. He wears a red and white headband with two feathers and stands barefoot on dry, grassy ground in front of a thatched structure.

entities.description: A full-body shot of a standing Black man wearing traditional African attire, including a red and brown striped tunic with fringed edges, a white sash tied at the waist, and a beaded necklace with a large circular pendant. He wears a headband with a single feather and stands barefoot on dry, dusty ground in front of a thatched-roof structure.
